title: Agreement off the anchor state
statement: Let $B$ be a finite machine over the Boolean alphabet, with designated states $q_v,q_i$. For every state $q$ of the body machine other than the administrative anchor state $0$, and for every input symbol and tuple of work-tape readings, the transition of the active body (parameter $false$) equals the transition of the stopped body (parameter $true$).
hypotheses_covered: A state $q$ of the body machine with $q\ne$ administrative anchor state $0$
An arbitrary input-symbol reading and tuple of work-tape readings
replaced:
The active and stopped variants of the enumerator body have identical transitions
at every control state other than the anchor; their tape counts and finite state
sets coincide.
